findings.failure_path: With 10 seconds of startup, a wrapper that charges startup but omits the eight-second probe charge gives formal review 20 seconds. That satisfies both numeric assertions and can return rc=0, although correct accounting would leave at most 12 seconds. The motivating comment explicitly allows startup exceeding 10 seconds, so the revised test remains blind to M4 on the loaded hosts it targets.
findings.smallest_fix: Assert the probe deduction independently of startup using same-invocation timing or a controlled clock, and include an M4 case with startup of at least eight seconds.
